he went into his house (now his windows were open in his room toward Jerusalem) and he kneeled on his knees three times a day
and prayed
and gave thanks before his God
as he did before.
And Daniel
on hearing that the writing had been signed
went into his house; (now he had windows in his room on the roof opening in the direction of Jerusalem;) and three times a day he went down on his knees in prayer and praise before his God
